methodology.spatialDistance: Haversine; degrees converted to radians; R=6371 km
methodology.distancePrecision: Station matching uses original coordinates; browser radius uses rounded public coordinates
methodology.stationSelection: Nearest among two supplied coastal stations, not the entire INMET network
methodology.prediction: Frozen train/validation/test chronological splits; only test scores published; see modelos.json

methodology.unit: Distinct original event, grouped by public base dimensions, vehicle profile, person profile and fatality flag
methodology.eventDeduplication: Vehicle quantities and person detail rows are aggregated before joining; event totals never sum a direct one-to-many join
methodology.fatality: fatal event flag from acidentes; nonfatal = n - fatal; nonfatal does not mean uninjured
methodology.vehiclePresence: Positive qtde_veiculos; unknown categories remain unknown. A vehicle type can occur in a fatal event without any death in that vehicle.
methodology.personAttribution: Person table has role/driver flag/injury but no person-to-vehicle link. Driver deaths cannot be attributed to a vehicle category in mixed events.
methodology.cyclist: CICLISTA is not a distinct person role in the supplied region. Bicycle-involved events can be counted from tipo_veiculo=BICICLETA; cyclist injuries/deaths are not identified separately.
methodology.unsupported: Ambulant food carts, wheelchairs, scooters, specific service uses and other absent types cannot be inferred from DESCONHECIDO, NAO_INFORMADO or another vehicle category.
methodology.overlap: Vehicle rankings overlap when an event contains multiple types. Union counts deduplicate events; intersection requires all requested types.
methodology.privacy: No original accident/person/vehicle identifiers are published; baseGroup is only a reference to an existing public aggregate row.
